 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY  
Two notable security events today: a high-risk test event in London and a medium-risk airport strike in Berlin. No immediate operational disruptions expected beyond localized impacts.

 KEY INCIDENTS  
- **London, UK**: Terrorism-related test event (Risk 8/10). System verification exercise—no active threat.  
- **Berlin, Germany**: Airport ground staff walkout (Risk 6/10). 24-hour strike announced, affecting flight operations.

✈️ AVIATION/OPS IMPACT  
Berlin airports experiencing delays/cancellations. Travelers advised to check flight status. London event is a drill—no real-world impact.

 OUTLOOK  
Monitor Berlin strike resolution; normal operations likely resume within 24h. London test concludes today—no further action needed.
